warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on every structural plan: 1-12 along x (11 bays x 4.00 = 44.00, left to right) and A-D along y (A at the top: A-B 4.00, B-C 4.00, C-D 2.50 = 10.50). Origin A1 (top-left) as the page PNG is rendered (upright; the PDF itself carries /Rotate 180).

Before-origin dummies share the first main line's prime sequence (section 4): x 1' -2.20 (roof eave, S-04) then 1'' -1.50 (slab/walkway edge, S-02/S-03), then 1''' 2.00 / 1'''' 3.00 in the 1-2 gap; y A' -2.20, A'' -1.50, then A''' 3.00 in the A-B gap.

S-03 prints two different local dimensions under row D: 1.50 beside grids 3/10 (the R5 edge of the 1.50 cantilever band) and 1.60 beside grids 4/9 (the B13 stair-box edge). Taken as two lines, D' 12.00 and D'' 12.10; by scale the stair-box line does sit lower than the R5 edge. The alternative (the whole 4-9 band at 1.60) is plausible, so D'' carries this note and the B13/R5 elements carry lowered scores.

Dimension sweep is PARTIAL: done for the four structural plan sheets S-01..S-04 (pages 13-16) only. The architectural plans/elevations/sections (pages 4-12) and the structural detail sheets (pages 17-29) were NOT swept in this op04 run (shutdown deadline) - so z_levels[] is empty and unassigned_dimensions[] holds only the S-02 detail numbers. This is an unread-sheet gap, not a clean sheet.

Element-internal dimensions are kept off the axes (section 4 rule 4 exception): the HC plank widths 0.60/1.20 and thickness, and the corbel (หูช้าง) 0.15/0.10 details on S-02 sit in unassigned_dimensions[] only.
